description: Search flights on WizTrip (the same search as wiz-trip.com/vuelos): one way or round trip, with adults, children and infants. `origin` and `destination` take an IATA code (city or airport: BUE, MVD, MIA) or a city name. Returns WizTrip's recommended flight, the cheapest and the shortest, plus more options, with selling prices in USD for the whole party, baggage, stops and schedule. The card shows them with a «Reservar ahora» button that opens the wiz-trip.com checkout of that flight. For a multi-city trip, or flight plus hotels, use trip_chat.

return_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, from today (2026-11-28) on. Omit for one way.
